title: Positive and Negative Affect Schedule
description: 20 feeling words rated 1–5 for a chosen time frame; two 10-item scales.

citation.text: Watson D, Clark LA, Tellegen A (1988). Development and validation of brief measures of positive and negative affect: the PANAS scales. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology 54(6):1063–1070.

scoring.text: Two sums (10–50 each): positive affect = items 1, 3, 5, 9, 10, 12, 14, 16, 17, 19; negative affect = items 2, 4, 6, 7, 8, 11, 13, 15, 18, 20. Scoring here follows the published literature; check it against the manual or form your lab holds before publishing.
